title: Qcqs pro-etale subsite and finite limits
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], using the size convention [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $\mathcal C$ be its full subcategory on quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], with finite pro-etale covering families [def-weil-pbc-proetale-covering]. Then $\mathcal C$ is a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], has fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product] computed as scheme fibre products, and its inclusion into $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ preserves fibre products and sends coverings to coverings. For every $T\in\mathcal C$, the slice $\mathcal C/T$ has finite limits computed as scheme limits over $T$. If $X$ itself is quasi-compact and quasi-separated, $\mathcal C$ has finite limits computed as scheme limits over $X$. Adjoining finitely many arrows of $\mathcal C$ with the same target to a finite covering family preserves the covering property.

proof.text: Use the existing finite limits of the small pro-etale category and preservation of pullbacks by its forgetful functor to schemes. For any limiting cospan cone whose objects are qcqs, the induced square in schemes is a pullback. Its left input arrow is quasi-compact and quasi-separated by qcqs permanence (1); base change makes the projection to the right input quasi-compact and quasi-separated, so permanence (2) makes the cone point qcqs. The full-subcategory limit-creation theorem now gives pullbacks and their preservation by both inclusions.

Pull back the pro-etale precoverage along the pullback-preserving qcqs inclusion. Its isomorphism, composition and base-change axioms construct a pretopology. Intersect this pretopology with the finite pretopology: its underlying precoverage is definitionally the prescribed qcqs precoverage. Sending a covering to a pro-etale covering is its first conjunct.

Every slice has the terminal identity object and inherits pullbacks. Apply the categorical construction of finite limits from a terminal object and pullbacks. The over-post functor preserves pullbacks because composition with the slice forgetful functor does, and that forgetful functor reflects limits. It preserves terminal objects because it maps the terminal identity to an identity. It therefore preserves finite limits; compose with the iterated-slice equivalence. When the base is qcqs, its identity object belongs to the qcqs full subcategory and is terminal. The inclusion preserves this terminal object and pullbacks, hence finite limits; compose with the ambient pro-etale forgetful functor.

Quasi-compact covering presieves are upward closed: inclusion of presieves gives a refinement map between their canonical pre-zero-hypercover families, and a family refined by a quasi-compact cover is quasi-compact. For the enlarged presieve, keep quasi-compactness and joint surjectivity from the original covering. Each added arrow is weakly etale by the between-objects lemma, implemented by WeaklyEtale.of_comp using its equation over the base. Finally, the union of the two finite sets of arrows is finite.
